## Changes

Describe the user-visible change and its scope.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated focused tests; `npm test` and `npm run check` pass.
- [ ] `npm run licenses:check` and `npm run release:check` pass.
- [ ] New public files are explicitly listed in `package.json`.
- [ ] No personal catalog, private skill document, local configuration or credentials are included.
- [ ] Installed source skills remain read-only and existing annotations/groups remain intact.
- [ ] UI changes were checked at desktop and mobile widths with synthetic fixtures.
- [ ] Dependency changes include updated license notices and a security review.
